reply_text:
*I’d block merging on two findings:*

1. *Whole-string validation is missing* — `src/validate.js:1–4`
   The regex accepts any string containing a valid substring. Verified that `Hello`, `hello world`, `../admin`, and `"hello\n"` all pass and produce paths through `pagePath`. Encoding doesn’t enforce the slug rules.
   *Fix:* Require a nonempty string with no characters outside `[a-z0-9-]`. Ensure trailing newlines are rejected too—JavaScript’s `$` anchor alone allows a final newline.

2. *Reserved slugs aren’t enforced* — `src/route.js:4–5`
   `isReserved` is never consulted by the validator or route builder. Verified that all four reserved words (`new`, `edit`, `admin`, `api`) produce page paths despite the documented prohibition.
   *Fix:* Reject reserved names before returning a page path, and test all four through `pagePath`, not just the standalone helper.

All 4 existing tests pass, but they don’t cover these failures. Add invalid-character and reserved-name rejection tests at the route boundary.

Reviewed `slug-validation` against `main`. No code changed.
